sloka: न वाक्यमात्रेण भवान् प्रधानो न कत्थनात् सत्पुरुषा भवन्ति।मयि स्थिते धन्विनि बाणपाणौ निदर्शय स्वात्मबलं दुरात्मन् ।। ६.७१.५८ ।।
transliteration: na vākyamātreṇa bhavān pradhāno na katthanāt satpuruṣā bhavanti।mayi sthite dhanvini bāṇapāṇau nidarśaya svātmabalaṁ durātman ।। 6.71.58 ।।

translations.english: "You are evil minded. By mere statement you people can't become good chiefs. I stand armed with a bow and arrow. Prove your strength."
